inventory.alt: Imagined scene: An unlettered scroll and reed pen rest by a window overlooking distant hills.
inventory.textBasis: 1:1–5,11–24: letter and recalled calling/travel. Blank scroll, pen and countryside are an imagined setting, not Paul’s actual document or a claimed composition site.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Papyrus rolls/edges/fibres, reed nib/shaft, ink-pot rim, jar handles, basket weave, shelf/window and road/hills checked. No writing, person or tiny animal; neutral natural morning, faded red cloth.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.

inventory.alt: Imagined scene: Bread, olives and clay cups share one low table in an empty courtyard.
inventory.textBasis: 2:9–14: fellowship and shared eating; empty courtyard meal recalls the issue of table fellowship without inventing a named participant or asserting that the dispute ended at this table.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Table legs/planks, bread crust/broken pieces, olives, cup/bowl rims, jug handles, woven cushions/rug/fringes, doorway/tree/courtyard checked. All seats empty. Green shade, muted purple and sage textiles.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.

inventory.alt: Imagined scene: A bare wooden cross stands on a rocky ridge beneath a pale sky.
inventory.textBasis: 3:1,13–14: crucifixion and tree/cross motif. Bare cross is a literary illustration, not the historical instrument, exact site or a portrait of Jesus.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Cross upright/beam joint and fastener, weathered wood, base set among stones, olive branches, red flowers and cloud/hill terrain checked. No human body, figure, inscription or hidden animal.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.

inventory.alt: Imagined scene: Cloud shadows cross the bare mountain ridges of Sinai beneath a wide blue sky.
inventory.textBasis: 4:21–31, especially 24–26: Sinai within Paul’s explicit allegory. Imagined mountain terrain, not proof of a located biblical site; no Hagar, Sarah or children visible.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Ridge lines, rock strata, shadow/light directions, foreground scrub and wide clouded blue sky checked. No anthropomorphic face, person, animal or literalized maternal allegory.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.

inventory.alt: Imagined scene: Ripe figs and green leaves grow on a branch in a quiet orchard.
inventory.textBasis: 5:22–23: fruit of the Spirit metaphor. Figs are an illustrative analogy; text specifies neither a fig species nor a literal count of fruits for the virtues.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Fig stems/attachments and terminal openings, branch joints, lobed leaves/veins, trunk bark, orchard and lower corners checked at native size. No remaining signature-like lettering, no people or animals.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.

inventory.alt: Imagined scene: New grain shoots rise from dark soil beside a field ready for harvest.
inventory.textBasis: 6:7–9: sowing and reaping analogy; foreground shoots and separate mature field/sheaf show different strips/stages, not one plant instantly maturing.
inventory.fullSizeReview: Seedling leaves/rows, separated planting strips/path, ripe wheat heads/stalks, sheaf cut ends/binding and ground contact, olive branches and dawn horizon checked. No farmer, animal or anatomy.
inventory.anatomy: No humans or animals visible; fingers, thumbs, limbs and aging comparisons not applicable.
